release_notes: SenseLab 0.6 supports ICECS text commands and the DielExct-Main-MB-V1.1 board profile. Adds fixed and sweep frequency settings from 5 to 100 kHz, PWM control, addressed configuration readback, a longer 15-second confirmation window for delayed wireless replies, bounded read-only query retries, delayed-reply handling, damaged JSON line recovery and input validation. Valid measurements require compatible board firmware with successful calibration.
